title: galium circaezans var. typicum
intro: Galium circaezans var. typicum, commonly known as Wild Licorice, is a type of flowering plant in the family Rubiaceae. It is traditionally used in herbal medicine, particularly in Native American and traditional Chinese medicine, to treat various health conditions. The health benefits of Wild Licorice include its ability to soothe digestive issues, reduce inflammation, and act as an expectorant to relieve respiratory problems. The therapeutic actions of Wild Licorice include its anti-inflammatory, anti-viral, and anti-bacterial properties, which are attributed to its bioactive constituents such as glycosides, flavonoids, and phenolic acids.
